## Smolder — G4 dragon (Friendship is Magic)

**Who she is:** Smolder is the orange, sharp-tongued teenage dragon whom Dragon Lord Ember sends to Twilight Sparkle's School of Friendship. One of the **Young Six**, she is **Garble's younger sister**, a surprise revealed in *Sweet and Smoky*. Beneath her tough, competitive exterior she enjoys cute things and tea parties. Fans sometimes tag her dress-and-tiara appearance as **“Princess Smolder”**; this is a dress-up scene, **not** a separate royal identity.

**Recognize her:** Orange scales; pale-gold belly, wing membranes and long curved horns; magenta-purple head crest and tail tuft; bright cyan eyes, wings and fangs. **Name:** Ember calls her **Smolder** in *School Daze – Part 1* (2018), so this is an in-dialogue TV name, not a fandom invention. **Speaking:** Yes, with substantial dialogue; English voice **Shannon Chan-Kent**.

**Where to see her:** *School Daze* (debut); *Molt Down*; *The Hearth's Warming Club*; *What Lies Beneath* (princess outfit and tea party); *Father Knows Beast* (helps Spike); *School Raze*; *Sweet and Smoky* (Garble, S9); and *The Last Problem* (future appearance). The licensed IDW *Feats of Friendship* miniseries (2019) also features her in its comic continuity.

**Sources:** [*School Daze* transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/School_Daze_-_Part_1); [*What Lies Beneath* transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/What_Lies_Beneath); [*Sweet and Smoky* transcript](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Transcripts/Sweet_and_Smoky); [voice cast](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt8074594/fullcredits/); [IDW miniseries details](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/My_Little_Pony%3A_Feats_of_Friendship).
